title: ADT supports South Florida first responders with $30,000 in donations
summary: ADT honored local first responders during Florida Atlantic University's Salute to Service night football game against Navy.
body_markdown:
ADT honored local first responders during Florida Atlantic University's Salute to Service night on Sept. 12 by donating $30,000 to three South Florida organizations that support first responders. The donations were announced during FAU football's 2026 home opener against Navy as part of the university's annual recognition of first responders, service members and military veterans.


ADT, which is based in Boca Raton, donated $10,000 each to the Boca Raton Police Foundation, the Boca Raton Firefighter & Paramedic Benevolent Fund and the Palm Beach County Sheriff's Foundation.


"First responders and service members dedicate their lives to serving and protecting our communities and country every day," said Dave Scott, ADT's Chief People & Administration Officer. "As a Boca Raton-based company, we're proud to join Florida Atlantic University's Salute to Service night with Navy and, as we reflect on the 25th anniversary of 9/11, recognize the courage, sacrifice and commitment of those who continue to serve others."


The donations reflect[ADT's commitment](https://newsroom.adt.com/adt-safe-places) to supporting first responders and building stronger, safer communities.


"ADT is a continuous contributor to our Foundation, which raises funds to help the brave men and women of Boca PD who keep our community safe," said Bob Tucker, Executive Director of the Boca Raton Police Foundation. "We appreciate ADT’s generosity and its commitment to first responders not only locally, but nationwide."


"We are truly thankful to ADT for continuing to stand beside our first responders and the Boca Fire Benevolent," said Alex Kennedy, President of the Boca Raton Firefighter & Paramedic Benevolent Fund. "For more than a decade, ADT's generosity has helped us be there for our firefighters, paramedics, their families and members of our community when they need it most."


"We're incredibly grateful to ADT for its longstanding support of the Foundation and its commitment to the first responder community," said Rick Seymour, Chairman of the Palm Beach County Sheriff's Foundation. "We share a commitment to safety, and this donation helps us continue supporting deputies and community programs in Palm Beach County."
